title: Render the proof command only for cell jobs

truths: render_brief writes the # Proof command section only when the spec carries a cell id
a brief for a job with no cell id renders no # Proof command section even when commands.test is set
existing mailbox tests that pin the proof section pass a cell id

action: Implement CONTEXT.md D8. In herding/mailbox.rs render_brief, build proof_command_block only when spec.cell_id is Some. Update existing tests in the same file that expect the proof section so they pass a cell id. No new tests (stdi-4 owns them). Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts. Rules for every cell: keep every rule and its why-clause (agents-block-diet D6); keep test-pinned wording unless this action names the pin; never add a size limit (D1). Write no code comments. Plain English, short sentences. Allowed bee commands: the cell verify, .bee/bin/bee knowledge check, .bee/bin/bee knowledge search. Do not run any bee dispatch or herding verb, not even its help. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. Commit only the files of this cell, one commit, trailer cell: <id>.
